nodes.question: How many fishing harbours are in the studied area?
nodes.answer: There are 14 fishing harbours in the area.
nodes.paragraph: 2007; Giannoulaki et al. 2013a; Colloca et al. 2015; Paradinas et al. 2022). The area has 14 fishing harbours, and five main commercial fishing fleets (in 2021 there were 191 bottom trawlers, 45 purse seiners, 228 small-scale vessels, and 6 bottom and 9 surface longliners, respectively) that fished 14.242 tonnes in 2021. The intense fishing activity results in high exploitation rates for most of the commercial species, mainly targeted by bottom trawlers and purse seiners (Merino et al. 2019). Fishing mostly takes places on a daily basis and the catch is commercialized in the national fresh fish markets, where we will focus the value chain analysis. Modelling approach We used the Ecopath with Ecosim (EwE) modelling approach, version 6.6.7. (Christensen et al. 2008 ), which includes the Ecopath mass-balance ecosystem model cou- pled to a value chain module (Christensen et al. 2011).
